name: Passepied
source:
A strange woman who takes Caprese into her home. Her Arcana is The Moon.
[spoiler]It turns out that she is long dead, and her ghost, tormented by being unable to accept the death of her husband in a long-ago war, is being manipulated by Tombeau and Dominante to drive Caprese into despair so they can take the Icons he has gathered so far.[/spoiler]
